tasks.title: Console setup e2e sends optional form tokens and checks sign-in replay
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all Behavior bullets, Checks 1-3 and Completion evidence; Rollout order (deploy merges before console). Read form_token from the same response as csrf, refresh it after each form response, and pass it only when present on every POST, including both flows if #563 has merged. Preserve steps 1-10 and capture the successful sign-in fields for an identical replay in step 8b without printing secrets. Console Check 14 owns the later token-enabled integration run; this child proves compatibility with console main without tokens.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; repository lint, typecheck and CLI tests pass with at least 80% line coverage
exit 0; no shellcheck diagnostics, including form_token_args, optional curl arguments and replay-body handling

acceptance.command: bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && scripts/check-setup.sh && bash scripts/check-setup.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0; the existing CI lint job's helper and static setup checks pass

acceptance.command: bash scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh && bash scripts/init-secrets.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0; the remaining existing CI lint job's script checks pass

acceptance.command: scripts/init-secrets.sh && docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml up -d --build && scripts/wait-ready.sh dev/compose.yaml 900 && bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml
acceptance.expected: exit 0 on fresh dev volumes with sibling service checkouts on main and console without form_token; output contains exactly 'ok: 8b replay check skipped: console without form_token' and preserves the existing steps 1-10, including setup 303, wrong code and password 401, connection test 200, signed-in GET / 200, closed setup 404, recreation with 0 setup code lines and no admin token in database files; no token, setup code or password is printed
exit 0 against the dev stack; the remaining dev job's source CLI integration check passes (PULSE_SRC_DIR points to the sibling service checkouts as in CI)
exit 0; the deploy pull request's required checks pass, including dev against console main without form tokens

the pull request records shellcheck output and the green dev job result with the literal 'ok: 8b replay check skipped: console without form_token'; it identifies console check 14 as the later proof of 'ok: 8b POST /sign-in replay 409 Already submitted', without claiming that token-enabled run happened in deploy
